title: Television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body, retro wood-coloured case -->
  <rect x='14' y='24' width='72' height='52' rx='7' fill='#c8792f'/>
  <rect x='14' y='24' width='72' height='52' rx='7' fill='#e0913f' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- inner bezel -->
  <rect x='20' y='30' width='52' height='40' rx='4' fill='#8a4d18'/>
  <!-- glowing screen -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='44' height='32' rx='3' fill='#1f3a5c'/>
  <!-- screen glow content: little sun and hills -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='6' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <path d='M24 60 Q32 50 40 58 Q46 52 52 60 L52 66 L24 66 Z' fill='#4fd08a'/>
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='44' height='32' rx='3' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.12'/>
  <!-- screen scanlines -->
  <rect x='24' y='45' width='44' height='1.5' fill='#2f5a86' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='44' height='1.5' fill='#2f5a86' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='24' y='59' width='44' height='1.5' fill='#2f5a86' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- control panel -->
  <rect x='76' y='34' width='7' height='32' rx='2' fill='#a85f22'/>
  <circle cx='79.5' cy='39' r='2.2' fill='#f2e9d8'/>
  <circle cx='79.5' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#d9c9a8'/>
  <rect x='77.5' y='52' width='4' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4215'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='76' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#9c5a1e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='76' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#9c5a1e'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <rect x='48' y='12' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#b86b26'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='3.5' fill='#ffcf4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='1.5' fill='#fff2b0'/>
</svg>
